title: 3438. Find Valid Pair of Adjacent Digits in String

examples.explanation: Digit '2' appears 2 times and digit '3' appears 3 times. Each digit in the pair "23" appears in s exactly as many times as its numeric value. Hence, the output is "23".
Digit '2' appears 2 times and digit '1' appears 1 time. Hence, the output is "21".
There are no valid adjacent pairs.
